what: Compact evidence of the Desktop re-run on the amended Step 0 (finding F1 of the first live H12 run): the maintainer ran the four unguided prompts once in a fresh Desktop folder, the executor read the host record and the passive observer's events offline. No raw transcript, lead sentence or discovery payload is published.

launchFormByParameterAcrossTheDesktopRun.note: every Agent launch of the three Desktop sessions read from the host records

toolErrors.error: no such tool available to this agent

deliverablesJudgedByReading: both files open with the stranger worry and the email follows the hypothesis; the email does not contain the word "trust", so the collector's word test under-reports

findings.summary: The launch form follows the run_in_background parameter: omitted gives "Async agent launched" (9 of 9 launches on 2026-10-15, 2 of 2 now), false gives the report inline in the hand-back frame (2 of 2 in the first run of 2026-10-19). The re-run lead omitted the parameter, so the foreground form F1 is about did not occur and the amended wording was not exercised for it.
findings.action: the amendment ships as an additive wording with that status; a foreground form can only be waited for, not asked for, in an unguided run

findings.summary: Every H12a line held on the async form under the amended text: no shutdown request or frame, no idle or lifecycle wait said, each report says no team shutdown applies, and the Stage 3 final report lists each worker's report status in place of a shutdown table, which is the wording the lifecycle text asks for.

The lead called the Desktop app's plan tool once; a native --agent lead does not hold it and the host answered "No such tool available". Harmless, one tool error, not seen in the first run of the day (Desktop 2.42304.0 then, 2.42304.2 now).

The revision reports of both workers carry "Open items" but not "Peer messages received", so the collector reads their latest attempt as lacking a section while the earlier attempts had both; the same pattern appeared in the first run of the day. Not part of the lifecycle text.

UI note of the maintainer: the Desktop background task keeps the heading of the first launch ("Consult Ava read-only") for every later turn of the same worker; a heading like "Ava - agency-growth-strategist" would show that it is the same worker. It comes from the description of the Agent call.
findings.action: a possible small follow-up for the lead's launch wording, not made

unverified: the foreground launch form under the amended wording (it did not occur in the re-run)
the CLI case on the amended Step 0 (not re-run; the team wording did not change)
behaviour over repeated runs: one more session
a failed or declined shutdown request, the nine-specialist flow, a provided SubagentHandback under the new wording
